title: Regional capacity tranche matrix & activation plan (NA/EU/APAC)
summary: Quarterly tranche-based forecast and activation plan for GPU fleets across North America, Europe, and APAC. Focus is on aligning reserved commitments, warm-pool sizing, and staggered activation windows to meet projected demand while keeping utilization between target bands. This sheet is meant to drive the next procurement sprint and the wave activation calendar.
primary_objectives: Define committed GPU tranches that balance cost and risk across regions
Map activation windows to procurement and image bake schedules
Set warm-pool sizing to reduce cold-start latency while preserving utilization targets
Surface key risks and mitigation actions for cross-region rollouts
assumptions: Traffic growth follows product telemetry + 25% headroom for spike scenarios
Average model token length and request mix unchanged from Feb 2026 baseline
New model onboarding (quantized 4-bit) reduces per-token GPU time by ~18% from current A100 runtime
Procurement lead time (vendor-to-activation) average = 6 weeks for cloud reserved capacity
Warm-pool can serve ~8% of peak RPS with <150ms latency overhead relative to hot instances
key_metrics: Target sustained utilization: NA 70%, EU 68%, APAC 65%
Peak headroom target (warm + burst): 20% above provisioned throughput
Warm-pool target share: 6-10% of region active GPU count depending on variance
SLO: 95th percentile token latency <= 220ms for interactive endpoints

risks_mitigation: Risk: Procurement delays push activation beyond forecast window -> Mitigation: Prepare template for expedited vendor onboarding and negotiate flexible start dates
Risk: Model on-boarding performance regression -> Mitigation: Reserve 10% buffer and run end-to-end perf smoke on canary traffic
Risk: APAC demand surges exceed provisioned capacity -> Mitigation: Pre-authorize cross-region burst routing for APAC -> NA fallbacks and pre-warm routes
Risk: Budget variance due to vendor price changes -> Mitigation: Hedge using shorter-term burst capacity and trigger auto-rollback to spot lanes if effective cost > threshold
operational_actions: Action: Create infra-runbook for each tranche that includes bake IDs, AMI tags, and env variables
Action: Implement metric alerts for real-time utilization drift (> +8% or -12%)
Action: Schedule dry-run activation two weeks prior to planned start to validate observability and rollout hooks
Action: Coordinate SRE on-call overlap during initial 72 hours of tranche activations
budget_estimates: Estimate-Q3-2026: NA $1.1M, EU $0.48M, APAC $0.22M (includes reserved & warm-pool)
Note: Estimates exclude pass-through network egress and ATO/compliance incremental costs
